column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline rules: IGNORE / WARN / FAIL per rule id. Everything not listed fails.
# 10049 is "Non-Storable Content": the HTML pages are deliberately not cached.
# 10027 "Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments": the HTML carries code comments on purpose.
# 10050 "Retrieved from Cache": CloudFront serving cached files is the point of the CDN.
